The renderer emits BOS once, followed by the dated system header. It trims ordinary message content using the checkpoint’s whitespace rules. It emits string tool responses as JSON strings under the
role, preserving their whitespace. A leading system message supplies the system content. Later system messages retain their position in the conversation.
The renderer supports the checkpoint’s

As a Swift API convenience, an empty conversation produces the dated system header and an optional assistant header. The reference’s conversation wrapper requires a nonempty message list, so this empty-input behavior is tested separately.
